title: Editor right-click submenu
summary: The drag-lint submenu of the code editor's right-click menu: the 1.52 caret commands, enabled by what the caret is on
intro: Read this when you want a drag-lint command for the code under the caret without going through the main menu. Right-click in the code editor and open the drag-lint submenu (after the Refactor group). It lists every 1.52 command whose row in the plugin command table names the editor surface; an item that needs a symbol is enabled only with an identifier under the caret, one that needs a finding only when a drag-lint finding is on the caret line. The submenu is hidden while none of its commands is switched on.

surfaces.caption: drag-lint
steps: Put the caret on the identifier or on the line of the finding
Right-click in the code editor and open the drag-lint submenu (after the Refactor group)
Choose the command; an item greyed out needs a symbol under the caret or a finding on the caret line
